description.value: Klippers Guest Suites are spacious, self-contained three-bedroom units on a working certified organic farm in Cawston, BC's Similkameen Valley, with each suite offering a private entrance, full kitchen, and scenic farmland views. The property is part of a larger agri-tourism destination that includes the Row Fourteen farm-to-table restaurant, Untangled Craft Cider, and a CSA operation, and guests can request fresh organic produce brought directly to their suite. It sits within easy reach of Okanagan and Similkameen wine-route cycling, with popular destinations like Osoyoos, Penticton, and Naramata nearby.
